docx_script = '''import openpyxl
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from collections import defaultdict

# Read inventory data
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('testbed/data/product_inventory.xlsx')
ws = wb['Products']

rows = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
    rows.append([str(c) if c is not None else '' for c in row])

headers = rows[0]
data = rows[1:]

# Compute summary stats
categories = defaultdict(list)
prices = []
for row in data:
    product_id, name, category, price, in_stock = row
    categories[category].append({'id': product_id, 'name': name, 'price': int(price), 'in_stock': in_stock})
    prices.append(int(price))

total_products = len(data)
total_categories = len(categories)
avg_price = sum(prices) / len(prices) if prices else 0
min_price = min(prices)
max_price = max(prices)

# Create Word document
doc = Document()

# Title
title = doc.add_heading('Product Inventory Summary', level=0)
title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

# Overview paragraph
doc.add_heading('Overview', level=1)
overview = doc.add_paragraph()
overview.add_run('This report provides a concise summary of the current product inventory based on data from ')
overview.add_run('product_inventory.xlsx').bold = True
overview.add_run('. The inventory contains ')
overview.add_run(f'{total_products} products').bold = True
overview.add_run(f' across {total_categories} categories.')

# Stock status note
stock_para = doc.add_paragraph()
run = stock_para.add_run('Stock Status: ')
run.bold = True
stock_para.add_run(f'All {total_products} listed items are marked as In Stock: Yes.')

# Key metrics
doc.add_heading('Key Metrics', level=1)
metrics = [
    ('Total Products', str(total_products)),
    ('Total Categories', str(total_categories)),
    ('Average Price', f'${avg_price:.2f}'),
    ('Price Range', f'${min_price} - ${max_price}'),
]
metrics_table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
metrics_table.style = 'Light Shading Accent 1'
metrics_table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
hdr_cells = metrics_table.rows[0].cells
hdr_cells[0].text = 'Metric'
hdr_cells[1].text = 'Value'
for metric, value in metrics:
    row_cells = metrics_table.add_row().cells
    row_cells[0].text = metric
    row_cells[1].text = value

doc.add_paragraph()

# Category breakdown
doc.add_heading('Category Breakdown', level=1)
cat_table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=3)
cat_table.style = 'Light Shading Accent 1'
cat_table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
hdr = cat_table.rows[0].cells
hdr[0].text = 'Category'
hdr[1].text = 'Product Count'
hdr[2].text = 'Avg Price'
for cat_name in sorted(categories.keys(), key=lambda x: len(categories[x]), reverse=True):
    items = categories[cat_name]
    cat_avg = sum(i['price'] for i in items) / len(items)
    row_cells = cat_table.add_row().cells
    row_cells[0].text = cat_name.title()
    row_cells[1].text = str(len(items))
    row_cells[2].text = f'${cat_avg:.2f}'

doc.add_paragraph()

# Full product listing
doc.add_heading('Complete Product Listing', level=1)
prod_table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=5)
prod_table.style = 'Light Shading Accent 1'
prod_table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
hdr = prod_table.rows[0].cells
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    hdr[i].text = h
for row in data:
    row_cells = prod_table.add_row().cells
    for i, val in enumerate(row):
        if i == 3:
            row_cells[i].text = f'${val}'
        else:
            row_cells[i].text = val

# Footer note
doc.add_paragraph()
footer = doc.add_paragraph()
run = footer.add_run('Note: ')
run.bold = True
run.font.size = Pt(9)
run2 = footer.add_run('All listed items are confirmed as In Stock (Yes). This summary was auto-generated from product_inventory.xlsx.')
run2.font.size = Pt(9)

# Save
doc.save('output/inventory_summary.docx')
print('Document saved to output/inventory_summary.docx')
'''
await write_file("./generate_summary.py", docx_script)
print("Script written")

await run_command("mkdir -p output")
gen_result = await run_command("python ./generate_summary.py")
print(gen_result)

file_check = await get_file_info("./output/inventory_summary.docx")
